instruction: Buy me a extension cord on amazon with a rating over 4.5 and have it delivered to my home address.
notes: Fixed the name clash: the predicate formerly called home-address is now (is-home ?a) so it no longer collides with the object home-address. Single-app Amazon purchase task. The product is a placeholder entity whose static facts (product_type == extension cord, rating above 4.5) must match the task spec before search_products can discover it; the agent must pick a result with rating strictly > 4.5 since min_product_rating is inclusive. The cart is cleared once (cart-may-have-items -> cart-empty) before adding exactly one unit so the resulting order has a single order item with quantity 1; CartEntry changes are ignored by evaluation. place_order requires the address flagged as the supervisor's Home address (selected by name from show_addresses) and a discovered payment card; no address or payment card is modified. The nullary (order-placed) fact is only produced by place_order under these constraints, so it serves as the goal condition and the precondition of supervisor-complete-task, which is forced to be last. No answer is passed to complete_task.
